name: Extra Tick
description: Widens the timing window of a click to up to 4 physics ticks, so frame-perfect inputs are easier to practice. Includes a status window and a toggle hotkey (Windows).

enabled.name: Enable Extra Tick
enabled.description: Master switch. Also flipped by the toggle hotkey while GD is focused (Windows).

tick-window.name: Tick Window Size
tick-window.description: Total number of physics ticks a click stays live, including the tick it happened on. <cy>1</c> = vanilla behaviour, <cy>4</c> = the click is re-applied for 3 extra ticks.

toggle-key.name: Toggle Hotkey
toggle-key.description: Key that turns Extra Tick on or off while Geometry Dash is the focused window (Windows only).

status-window.name: Show Status Window
status-window.description: Shows a small always-on-top window next to the game that says whether Extra Tick is ON or OFF (Windows only). Drag it anywhere. It will not show over exclusive fullscreen; use windowed or borderless.

practice-only.name: Practice / Test Mode Only
practice-only.description: When on, assist only runs in Practice Mode or a Startpos test run. When off (default), it also works in normal mode.

debug-log.name: Debug Logging
debug-log.description: Log every injected tick to the Geode console. Useful when tuning the window or after a GD update.
